summary: Implemented worker graceful shutdown and bounded cleanup using signal handling and schedulers.shutdown(). Prevented duplicate scheduled work via a local OS-level file lock in worker_main.py, documenting clearly that this does not constitute true HA distributed locking. Fixed broken MetricCurrent.updated_at reference in aggregator. Tested API/worker separation, lock mechanism, and stop/restart flows locally. Addressed run_all.bat confusion by renaming it to start_services.bat and providing a truthful run_tests.bat.

tests.command: $env:PYTHONPATH='backend'; conda run --no-capture-output -n monitor_backend python -m pytest backend/tests/test_worker_lifecycle.py -v

external_blockers: 실행 topology 확정 대기 (Actual High Availability distributed locking mechanism depends on topology and DB support)
